key_impacts: Fukushima Daiichi nuclear plant units were damaged, requiring long-term decommissioning.
Significant generation of contaminated water onsite; countermeasures implemented to reduce inflow.
About 1,100,000 m3 of ALPS-treated water stored onsite as of October 2018.
